entities.summary: José Vidal-Ribas Güell was a Spanish businessman, tennis player, and sports manager, who presided over several important entities, such as the Real Club de Tenis Barcelona from 1920 to 1929, the Royal Spanish Tennis Federation from 1924 to 1929, and FC Barcelona for a month in 1942.
